pages.text: A few rules make life easier for a small group:$(li)One sleeper is enough to skip the night.$(li)No phantoms.$(li)Creepers, ghast fireballs and wither skulls do not break blocks. Endermen do not pick blocks up.$(li)Villagers still farm, sheep still eat grass.$(li)An axe fells a whole tree at once; sneak to cut a single log.

$(li)Nothing is lost when you die: it waits in your $(item)grave$() (see Party). With friends online you fall $(item)downed$() first, and they can pick you up.$(li)Dungeon chests are personal: everyone finds their own loot in the same chest.$(li)Mining is blocked inside many surface dungeons (see World & Danger).
